Description: Worn and well-used, this heavy blade bears the symbol of the Legion of the West Weald.
Notched and stained, the steel blade of this dagger is still sharp.
Constructed with a single pearl mounted in a gold and silver setting, this ring is a proper gift for any intended lover.
Well made for a Goblin bow, the string is made from the tendons of some unknown beast.
A makeshift butcher's blade, this axe is more fearsome than many found on the battlefield.
Meant for a traveler's protection, the waistband is nevertheless attractive and can be worn on all occasions.
Constructed of dark wood and green gems, this staff bristles with dark energy.
This container holds an assortment of Clothier materials.
Slightly leaf-shaped, this Wood Elf sword bears the symbol of the Recollection's leadership.
A crystal staff seemingly made of unmelting ice, this weapon bites the hands of all but its wielder with everlasting cold.
This large shield bears the symbol of the Legion of the West Weald.
White and seemingly made of bone, this skullcap would be intimidating in any company.
Soft and well-worn, these boots are proofed against weather and hard roads.

Item Name: Made from horn and sinew, this bow gleams with the passion of its wielder.
Made from the hide of some long-extinct beast, these gloves provide a grip as fine as bare skin.
Constructed from the mandibles of a giant spider, this shoulder armor provides resistance to all venoms.
The ring's band is composed of multiple, interwoven threads.
The smooth fabric of these leggings glistens in light and fades in darkness, protecting the wearer from both sight and harm.
An elaborate helm marking the wearer's favor in West Weald, this Legion helm stands tall on its owner's head.
This container holds an assortment of Woodworking materials.
A thick belt made from bronze and steel rings, the buckle displays the head of a snarling bear.

Description: A brutal-looking weapon, ideal for crushing skulls.
A fine wine, fit for healing body, soul, and mind.
Seemingly made almost entirely from secret pockets, this chest piece provides limited protection but ideal hiding spots for those items needed by any investigator.
Made to support legionaries who stand long watches, these greaves provide protection and comfort.
The head of this staff splits, almost as if cloven by lightning.

Item Name: An attractive necklace constructed from myriad bits of glass and stone, it melds different colors and facets together in harmony.

Description: A heavy stone band that appears chipped and nearly broken, this ring appears to have been made that way to lessen the chance of theft.
